snippet.title: Psychotrons Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5084020/Psychotrons/?l=italian

The player is Agent Plotkin an elegant truffle-guy that explores the alleys of a vast city slum called O’PsyTown, he has one mission: to rebuild the brain of Professor Pavlita searching for all his lost Neurons.
Professor Pavlita opened the gate of the ID (his subconscious) and from it the PSYCHOTRONS got out and they stolen his neurons.

Publisher: Paolo Bigazzi Alderigi
Developer: Komplex
Release date: 6 November 2026
Store: Steam
